measurementDefinition.name: Measuring the Compression Dividend
measurementDefinition.role: Primary proposed measurement and accounting layer for governed reuse versus matched recomputation
measurementDefinition.adaptiveDecisionRule: Recompute when reconstruction is cheaper, the task is novel, prior state is unreliable, verification burden is high, or reuse overhead exceeds avoided work. Preserve and reuse when trustworthy prior structure prevents more work than the full reuse system consumes.
measurementDefinition.dynamicReuseFrontier: The workload-dependent boundary where Net Reuse Benefit = 0 and the preferred strategy switches between matched recomputation and governed reuse.
measurementDefinition.economicInterpretation: Falling inference prices can move the frontier outward, while larger repeated contexts, higher recurrence, agentic workflows, or expensive reconstruction can move it toward governed reuse.
measurementDefinition.qualityBoundary: Matched recomputation and governed reuse must satisfy the same declared Quality Gate before efficiency differences are interpreted.
measurementDefinition.physicalResourceBoundary: Computational and economic measurements do not automatically establish lower energy, water, emissions, or lifecycle impact.
measurementDefinition.evidenceBoundary: This measurement architecture is proposed and falsifiable. It is not itself a canonical claim, empirical result, or registered Naturepedia Plate.

netReuseBenefit.definition: Whether avoided recomputation exceeds the complete cost required for valid reuse

dynamicReuseFrontier.definition: The moving workload-dependent boundary where the preferred strategy switches between matched recomputation and governed reuse

reuseBreakEvenPoint.definition: The earliest valid reuse event at which cumulative avoided recomputation offsets initial and cumulative reuse-system cost

compressionDividend.definition: The cumulative advantage produced when valid reuse continues to reduce accepted-task cost after complete reuse-system cost is included

knowledgeYieldPerCompute.definition: How productively computational resources create accepted, validated, persistent, reusable task-relevant knowledge

operationalAccounting.avoidedRecomputationFormula: Avoided Recomputation = Matched Baseline Work - Residual Work Required After Reuse
operationalAccounting.netReuseBenefitFormula: Net Reuse Benefit = Avoided Recomputation - Preservation - Retrieval - Verification - Maintenance - Repair
operationalAccounting.cumulativeDividendFormula: D(k) = cumulative avoided recomputation - initial reusable-state cost - cumulative retrieval - cumulative verification - cumulative maintenance - cumulative repair
operationalAccounting.breakEvenCondition: k* is the earliest valid reuse event where D(k) >= 0
operationalAccounting.interpretationBoundary: Avoided recomputation is not automatically equal to the full matched baseline because residual work can remain after retrieval and reuse.
operationalAccounting.qualityBoundary: Both matched recomputation and governed reuse must pass the same declared Quality Gate before efficiency comparison.
operationalAccounting.universalityBoundary: These are proposed operational accounting relationships, not universal physical, mathematical, or economic laws.

matchedEvaluation.qualityGatePurpose: Efficiency or resource differences count only after both conditions satisfy the same declared acceptance requirements
matchedEvaluation.adaptiveDecisionRule: Use the measured workload-dependent frontier rather than assuming reuse or recomputation always wins.
matchedEvaluation.agenticBoundary: High-recurrence agentic workflows may increase the value of trustworthy reusable state when repeated reconstruction is substantial.
matchedEvaluation.complexityBoundary: No universal asymptotic complexity class is assigned to all recomputation or reuse workloads; actual cumulative work should be measured.

verificationComplexityBoundary.interpretation: Verification cost must be measured for the actual implementation rather than assumed away.

operatingRegimes.name: Expensive Recomputation
operatingRegimes.interpretation: Preservation and verification investment may be recovered after relatively few valid reuse events when reconstruction is costly.

operatingRegimes.name: Commodity Recomputation
operatingRegimes.interpretation: Recomputation may correctly remain preferable when reconstruction is cheap, simple, infrequent, or rapidly changing.

operatingRegimes.name: High-Recurrence Agentic Work
operatingRegimes.interpretation: Trustworthy reuse may become increasingly valuable when agents repeatedly rebuild long contexts, reasoning chains, tool sequences, or canonical state.

frameworkEvaluationPath.interpretationBoundary: Canonical authority, measurement definition, a measured Dynamic Reuse Frontier, a reuse break-even crossing, a positive Net Reuse Benefit, a positive Compression Dividend, protocol publication, benchmark implementation, schema validity, machine discovery, licensing, x402 payment, settlement, retrieval, and successful delivery do not by themselves establish independent empirical validation, universal applicability, model certification, production certification, or guaranteed performance improvement. Each result remains bounded to the tested model, workload, implementation, Quality Gate, cost assumptions, measurement window, and evidence state.
